My first time making a mod, I only went through a simple test and it ran normally on my game
The module I am personally using: Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cutter Aesthetics https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450
Stardewvalley anime mods  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839
Special thanks to the author of Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics! I learned his code format and finally got my mod to run normally!!!! Thank you.
His homepage https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303
Baechu's Portraits （Content Patcher）  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8942
Baechu-Style Sprites  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9016
I want my beautification mod to be less abrupt in the game, so I learned from the styles of the three authors mentioned above
I came up with the idea of creating my own mod in order to make Alex's image more in line with the dialogue expansion module I am using
I strongly recommend it to everyone here
Alex's dialogue expansion  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15073
You can experience a more sunny and romantic Alex, but it may only be in Chinese
18_MarriageDialogueAlex  https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25573
This mod is also only available in Chinese. I want to draw this mod mainly for it, which includes some adult and SM content. If you can't accept it, just enjoy the one above!
As I am completely a code novice, if any errors occur during the gameplay, please let me know and I will do my best to correct them
